why: The landmine blocked-fire-ring.ts records, reproduced on this arm: skipping the scale term under reduced motion instead of writing a rest scale freezes an ALREADY-LIVE flash at whatever size it had collapsed to when the preference flipped, rather than moving it to rest. Reachable only mid-flight, because `prefers-reduced-motion` is a live media query -- the test that sets the preference BEFORE spawning stays green under this, which is why one reduced-motion case is not enough.
killedBy: blocked-fire muzzle flash (issue #516, parent #356) snaps an ALREADY-LIVE flash to full size when reduced motion turns on mid-flight
